previously McKinsey, @georgiatech, @stackfolio (acquired),

tweets.text: Imagine replacing every employee at American Airlines, Home Depot or Medtronic with a math olympiad who approached every task as a problem of discovery. Costs would not fall, but would rise rapidly and dramatically as every routine decision would be re-examined from first principles. The organization would drown in intelligence it cannot productively use or absorb
Actually instinct + Grokbot = no more Claude (except for extremely intense research) https://t.co/hO3d3xtOkP
Progress will not be measured by how much intelligence a company can afford to consume, but by how quickly intelligence consumed per successful outcome falls toward zero https://t.co/RPc19BPSs0
